Ensuring availability for Client to log Incidents, Problems, Change Requests and Service Requests by phone or email 24 hours per day, 365 days a year.

Assist Assistant DC Manager / DC Facility Supervisor to manage day to day FM operations of accounts.
Ensure fulfilment of scheduled commitments for FM teams.
Ensure good planning and execution of service schedules.

title: ERP System Engineer (Kingdee)
short_description: Ensure the reliable operation of Kingdee Cloud Starry Sky ERP, warehouse, and barcode systems to support business operations.
job_description:
As our ERP System Engineer (KINGDEE), you will be responsible for the daily operation, maintenance, user support, and optimization of the Kingdee ERP system, covering Procurement, Sales, Inventory, Production, Planning, and Finance module.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. DAILY SYSTEM MAINTENANCE
Manage account permission, conduct daily system inspections, troubleshoot issues, handle document and process problems, and ensure the normal operation of all Kingdee Cloud Starry Sky modules (Procurement, Inventory, Production, Planning, Finance). Assist inf coordinating supply chain, production, financial daily operations, and monthly reconciliation
2.
EMPLOYEE PRACTICAL TRAINING
Conduct Kingdee system operation training for various departments, standardize employee input, ordering inbound and outbound, reporting, reconciliation and other operation processes, answer daily system usage questions and prepare operation documents.
3.
REPORT DEVELOPMENT & OPTIMIZATION
Based on business needs, develop, customize, adjust and update daily business reports and statistical reports.
4. BUSINESS PROCESS OPTIMIZATION
Analyze production, inventory and financial workflow issues, optimize system processes and parameter configurations, and coordinate with the vendor for system bugs and version upgrade handling.
5. MATERIAL PLANNING & CONTROL
Plan, monitor and control factory material requirements, ensure materials arrive on time and meet production scheduling requirements.
6. WAREHOUSE & BARCODE SYSTEM MANAGEMENT
Support warehouse operations, barcode system management, inventory accuracy, material traceability, and overall warehouse efficiency.
QUALIFICATIONS:
1-2 years of practical and maintenance experience in ERP system (KINGDEE)
Proficient in daily operation and maintenance, permission configuration, and document process adjustment of Kingdee. Able to independently handle common system failures.
Have the ability to develop simple Kingdee reports and create custom reports, and proficient in basic
Microsoft SQL Server
data query and organization.
Minimum 1 year of experience in factory material control / barcode system / warehouse management, with a background in manufacturing factories preferred.
Possess good communication skills, able to independently conduct employee training and answer questions, meticulous and responsible in work.
Experience in development and process optimization is preferred
LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS:
ENGLISH: REQUIRED
MANDARIN: PREFERRED

title: Mine Technical & Development (MTD) Manager
short_description: Lead technical mining operations in South Sumatra. Manage teams, optimise extraction, drive innovation.
job_description:
About the role
PT Baramutiara Prima is seeking an experienced
Mine Technical & Development (MTD) Manager
to join our operations team in South Sumatra. This is a full-time position that plays a critical role in driving technical excellence and sustainable development across our mining operations. The MTD Manager will be responsible for overseeing technical strategies, optimizing mining processes, and ensuring compliance with industry standards whilst contributing to the long-term growth and profitability of the organization. This role reports to senior management and requires a strategic mindset combined with hands-on operational expertise.
Key responsibilities
Manage all Mine Technical Development functions including mine planning, geology & exploration, survey, geotechnical, coal quality management, mine technical support
Develop and implement technical strategies and mine development plans to maximize resource recovery and operational efficiency.
Oversee geotechnical assessments, mine geology, and resource modelling to support planning and decision-making
Monitor and optimize mining methods, extraction techniques, and equipment utilization to enhance productivity and safety performance
Manage feasibility studies, mine engineering projects, and capital development initiatives from conception through implementation
Ensure compliance with mining regulations, environmental standards, and health and safety requirements across all technical operations
Lead the technical team, including geologists, engineers, and technicians, providing mentorship and fostering a culture of continuous improvement
Collaborate with operations, maintenance, and planning teams to resolve technical challenges and improve operational performance
Conduct regular audits and reviews of mining practices to identify opportunities for cost reduction and productivity enhancement
Prepare technical reports, performance metrics, and recommendations for senior management
Manage relationships with external contractors, consultants, and regulatory bodies on technical matters
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Mining Engineering, Geology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualifications are highly desirable
Minimum 10-12 years of progressive experience in mining operations, with at least 8 years in a technical or supervisory management role
Strong knowledge of mining methods, equipment, geology, and resource estimation techniques relevant to underground or open-pit mining
Proven expertise in mine planning, feasibility studies, and capital project delivery within the mining industry
Strong understanding of Indonesia mining regulations, environmental compliance, RKAB and K3 mining requirements.
Solid understanding of mining regulations, environmental compliance, and health and safety standards in Indonesia or similar jurisdictions
Proficiency in mine planning software (Minescape, Surpac,Vulcan,Minex, Datamine, 3D modelling tools) and data management systems
Excellent problem-solving abilities with a focus on practical solutions and operational efficiency
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present technical information to diverse stakeholders
High level of integrity, reliability, and commitment to safe working practices and environmental stewardship
Flexibility to work in remote locations and willingness to undertake site visits as required
Apply now
If you meet the above criteria and are interested in this opportunity, please submit your CV ,any supporting documentation to our human resources department. We look forward to hearing from you.
